summary: Phase 16 closing task: reconciled the canonical G6/G8 documentation, performed the G6/G8 integration verification without a live host, corrected the pinned-host testing document, and registered the phase's accepted limitations. tests/ArrTags.Tests/GoalG6G8IntegrationTests.cs adds 4 deterministic cases following the task 9.5 Goal A precedent. Two compose the real byte save path: operator display values are converted through the code-owned ByteLimitUnits/ByteLimitField mapping and sent as JSON numbers through the pinned dashboard POST deserialization (JsonDefaults.Options), the real Plugin.UpdateConfiguration validate/persist/activate path, and the real XML configuration boundary; the edited values and every minimum, default, and maximum of all seven byte limits (including the three 64 KiB minima) persist and display back exactly. Two compose the G8 chain: the code-owned RestartRequiredSettings classification equals the page restartRequiredFields mirror, every restart-required setting carries its exact classification-derived note text (mixed clause iff mixed), the reminder snapshots/compares exactly the mirror's config.Limits keys, the modal message states the restart requirement and defers the mixed nuance to the note text, and the four restart-required byte limits use one element id/property key across the classification, byte mapping table, native input step, note, and reminder detection domain (their bounds re-save to the exact persisted bytes; a real edit converts to a different number). The page JavaScript (conversion and modal) cannot be executed here (no JS runtime; the pinned live matrix runs --nowebclient), so those halves are verified structurally against the code-owned sources and the embedded page resource. Documentation: ADR-028 gains an Implementation note (v1.2, tasks 16.1-16.6); architecture 06/12, data-model 03-12, README, and the ADR-016 index row are reconciled for G6/G8; docs/limitations/accepted.md gains V12-G6-1 (legacy in-range off-step byte value), V12-G8-1 (modal best-effort/shim, structural-only verification), and V12-G8-2 (inert global OperationalLimits.RequestTimeoutSeconds) with index rows and state.json accepted IDs; docs/testing/jellyfin-12-musl-test-host.md is corrected (the pinned musl archive ships jellyfin/jellyfin-web/, 2363 entries; --nowebclient only means the live matrix does not serve or exercise it). No shipped G6/G8 behavior changed, no endpoint or dependency added, no commit created, and the phase was not marked complete (the orchestrator owns Gate 16 and the tag).

interpretations.question: What form should the G6/G8 integration verification take for the page's JavaScript half?
interpretations.chosen: Real deterministic C# tests for the byte save path and all min/default/max round-trips; structural composition tests (over the embedded page and the code-owned sources) for the page conversion/mirror/notes/reminder domain and the modal message, with the non-executability stated in the test class documentation, the changelog, and the register.
interpretations.basis: The repository deliberately has no JavaScript runtime and no test executes the page; the task 9.5 Goal A precedent composes the real C# seams and records what cannot be executed; the task brief explicitly requires documenting what can only be verified structurally.
interpretations.impact: The G6/G8 page behavior (conversion and modal) is not executed by any test or by the pinned live matrix; this residual is registered as V12-G8-1 and stated in the changelog, so no overclaim is made.

test_sensitivity: Probe A: changing the ProviderResponseLimitBytes step from 64 KiB to 96 KiB in ByteLimitUnits failed 2 focused cases (Failed 2, Passed 2) - the edited-value save-path case and the min/default/max save-path case. This proves the two byte-path tests are sensitive to a broken code-owned mapping/conversion (the edited 0.125 MB value no longer lands on a step and both cases fail).

Probe B: flipping the SourceArtifactLimitBytes 'mixed' flag in the page restartRequiredFields mirror failed 1 case (Failed 1, Passed 3) - the classification/mirror/notes composition. This proves that surface catches drift between the code-owned classification and the page mirror or note wiring.

Probe C: changing the sourceArtifactLimitBytes input step attribute from 0.0625 to 0.125 failed 1 case (Failed 1, Passed 3) - the G6/G8 identity case. This proves the intersection test catches an element/step mismatch between the byte mapping and the restart-required input.

Probe D: removing the mixed immediate-application clause from the sourceArtifactLimitBytes note failed 2 cases (Failed 2, Passed 2) - the note/mirror composition and the G6/G8 identity case. This proves the note-text assertions catch a note that contradicts the classification's mixed flag.

Structural-only verification (no test can fail because no runtime executes it): the page's inline JavaScript conversion algorithm and the Dashboard.alert modal are asserted as exact text/placement over the embedded page resource; a browser-level change that preserved those strings would not be caught. The byte conversion is additionally exercised as real C# through ByteLimitUnits in the same tests. This residual is the registered V12-G8-1 limitation.

Existing guards were not modified or weakened: the task 16.2 SettingClassification constructor guard and reflection completeness test, the task 16.3 note tests, and the task 16.5 reminder tests remain in the suite (the full 1819-case run includes them).
